retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1960s album layout featuring a vibrant red field, a heart-shaped photographic cutout of a group, and bold, wide sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: heart-shaped photo mask on red background
excludeWhen: modern minimalist digital aesthetics are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A saturated red square composition dominated by a large heart-shaped photographic window in the lower-left quadrant containing a black-and-white portrait of four men. The top half is occupied by heavy, wide-set sans-serif text in white and cyan, while the right side features a vertical list of tracks in a condensed sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Large heart-shaped mask containing high-contrast B&W photography against a solid red field
Extreme horizontal stretch in header typography contrasting with vertical condensation in tracklist
Primary color palette of bright red, cyan blue, and stark white
Asymmetrical balance with heavy top-left text and bottom-left imagery
coreInvariants: Heart-shaped framing for the primary subject
Cyan and white color scheme for all typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Heart-shaped photo mask positioned in the lower-left, occupying approximately 40% of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white numeral and bold header text at the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left header, moves across to the right, drops down to the heart-shaped photo, and finishes on the tracklist at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of flat red space around the central heart and between text blocks.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Stark white for primary headers and B&W photography highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright cyan blue for secondary headers and track titles
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red with high-value white and cyan for maximum legibility and pop-art impact.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme horizontal expansion for main headers
Square-ish proportions in the main title
Condensed, tall proportions for the tracklist
characterSpecificRedesigns: Large, oversized numeral integrated into the main title line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-wide display headers and ultra-condensed tracklist fonts.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider lines implied by text alignment

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, mid-century technical feel of the main headers.
Matches the tall, narrow feel of the tracklist on the right.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid vibrant red square background. In the lower-left quadrant, place a large heart-shaped mask containing a high-contrast black and white photograph of a smiling vocal group in formal wear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, extra-wide sans-serif text in white and cyan at the top. On the right side, add a vertically stacked list of text in a condensed sans-serif font using cyan and white.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, bright red?
Is the photo contained within a sharp-edged heart shape?
Are the main headers significantly wider than they are tall?
Is the color palette strictly red, cyan, white, and B&W?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red (from tomato to crimson)
mustRedesign: Original artist names and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Verify the heart shape is symmetrical and clearly defined.
Ensure the cyan text is legible against the red background.
Check that the header text feels horizontally stretched.
Confirm the B&W photo has high contrast with deep blacks and bright whites.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid Red Background + Heart-Shaped B&W Photo Mask + Extended Sans-Serif Headers + Condensed Tracklist = 1960s Pop Album Aesthetic
